facts.fact: Liberia's National Data Governance Policy says the National Data Center, spearheaded by the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications for government and private sector use, is located at the state-owned national operator LTC-Mobile and is being upgraded under the World Bank GREAT Project; it does not itself say who owns the centre, only that it sits at a state-owned operator. Dated by the document's published date (March 2026), as it gives no other date.

The policy states that GovNet, which connects more than 107 ministries, agencies and commissions, suffers from the absence of a centralised data centre, and that a national data centre still needs to be established or designated to host critical government datasets. Dated by the document's published date (March 2026), as it gives no other date.

systems.owner: state-owned national operator LTC-Mobile (hosts it; ownership of the centre itself not stated)

note: No hosted fact: government hosting in the National Data Center is only targeted (LRA, Civil Service Agency) or future (NIR, LRA via Buchanan), not stated as current; Buchanan Tier III+ is under development.
